Bring the context that matters.

A little preparation can make your next conversation more focused. Keep the originals and decide what you want to discuss.

  • Your main questions and what you would like help with.
  • Relevant reports, prescriptions and their dates.
  • Notes about meals, movement, symptoms and your everyday routine.
  • Any preferences or practical constraints you want your professional to understand.
Before sharing information

Confirm which information the service needs and which sharing controls are available in the released app. No health information is uploaded or shared from this page.

Questions before you choose.

Are consultations included in Orb Pro?
Professional care is optional and purchased separately. The final app-plan inclusions and each care package must be confirmed before purchase. You can compare the current app-plan preview on the Plans page.
Which professional will I speak to?
That depends on the service you select and the professionals available for it. A verified roster, consultation types and booking destination are still awaiting confirmation.
Does Orb replace a doctor?
Orb supports everyday understanding and planning. Diagnosis, clinical assessment and treatment decisions belong with appropriately qualified professionals.
How is Blueprint different from ongoing care?
Blueprint is an assessment experience that brings information into findings, priorities and next steps. Ongoing consultations or follow-up depend on the separate service purchased. Package inclusions are awaiting confirmation.
